claims_and_decisions.claim: Every FinBIF Document ID uniquely represents one exactly geolocated site with independently verified repeated field visits

claims_and_decisions.limitation: Filled slots do not prove physical visit or absence effort; current instructions do not require surveys every weekend.

claims_and_decisions.limitation: Target can be observed flowering, weekend nonreport, spatially broad area and phenology; not site occupancy.

claims_and_decisions.claim: All ABSENT records mean the participant actually surveyed that scheduled weekend and did not see flowers
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Official current directions permit skipping weekends; precise old form defaults/effort provenance unverified.

claims_and_decisions.limitation: Semantics and source coverage decisive. Alternative baseline: established phenology/missing-data/occupancy theory.

claims_and_decisions.claim: Use exact source grouped split by Form/Document ID, not record split, for any follow-up prediction study
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Avoid cross-record dependence and source identity leakage; still need independent target/effort.

claims_and_decisions.claim: Promote universal MQR 5.5 new law from R123/R124 classical seasonal checklist reconstruction
